nominal_rationale: At observation step h=0.02 and process noise sigma=0.05, sigma_obs=sigma*sqrt(h/2)=0.005 makes the forward-difference observation-noise scale sqrt(2)*sigma_obs/h equal to the process-increment scale sigma/sqrt(h). It is also approximately one percent of the initial coordinate scale.
pairing_policy: Within each repetition, every observation-noise level uses the same latent training, validation, and test trajectories; the same standard-normal training and validation observation-error arrays scaled by sigma_obs; the same weak pair samples; the same data-dependent test construction rule; and the same strong-form target subset.
failure_policy: Retain every predeclared repetition, nonconverged path candidate, boundary selection, rank deficiency, nonfinite coefficient, and missing metric. Do not rerun to improve ordering or monotonicity.
manuscript_policy: Keep the existing noise-free-observation 10D result as a clean baseline. Do not modify the manuscript until the complete sweep and revised cross-example table have been reviewed.
